title: Fence delivery against activation lease expiry
objective: Correct the activation-lease defect found by task-final-live-resume-proof-2. The lease must remain valid for the complete bounded plain codex resume confirmation and cleanup interval, and the post-transport delivery fence must reject a lease whose expires_at has passed even when no takeover changed its token.
scope: src/wakeup.js activation lease duration and decision fence
relevant_context: The transport confirmation bound is 120 seconds and helper lifecycle bound is 135 seconds.
The current default activation lease is 30 seconds and decisionFenceCurrent checks identity but not expires_at.
A lease that expires during a transport makes delivery uncertain and must not produce a delivered receipt or be blindly replayed.
Canonical argv, exact rollout evidence, temporary process cleanup, Herdr continuity, busy behavior, post-transport fence validation, and pause semantics remain fixed.
acceptance_criteria: the activation lease duration safely exceeds the complete 135-second helper lifecycle bound
decisionFenceCurrent deterministically rejects malformed, expired, and exact-boundary expires_at values
post-transport expiry without takeover records UNCERTAIN and produces no delivered receipt, state activation, telemetry, or HOST_WAKE_DELIVERED event
normal unchanged unexpired delivery still succeeds exactly once
expected_deliverable: A minimal activation-lease duration and expiry correction with deterministic regressions.

may: read repository and named compact evidence
modify src/wakeup.js, directly related tests, and minimal docs
run focused and full local verification
may_not: invoke live wake, signal live runtime, replay or rewrite historical events
change canonical message or argv, policy, objective, identity, binding, pause behavior, or host configuration
modify siblings, push, merge, deploy, install, or initialize a repository
